stops.name: sandstone cliffs
stops.detail: Experience the beauty of Saxony's only national park and discover the wealth of flora and fauna on and between the sandstone cliffs in the national park region.

stops.name: table mountains
stops.detail: The majestic table mountains and the deeply carved Elbe valley characterise the cross-border Elbe Sandstone Mountains on a large scale.
